programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Athletic - Sevilla
programme.desc: Un ilusionado conjunto vasco tras conseguir la clasificación para la Champions y retener a su figura, Nico Williams, recibe a un Sevilla que quiere volver a la élite del fútbol español.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: At. Madrid - Elche
programme.desc: El conjunto colchonero se enfrenta al Elche tras caer de forma sorpresiva en la primera jornada de liga ante el Espanyol.

programme.title: El Arquitecto. Del mito al desafío
programme.desc: Análisis en profundidad sobre la figura de Xabi Alonso, el entrenador del Real Madrid CF y actualmente en el centro de todas las miradas. El documental contrapone su etapa gloriosa como futbolista con sus éxitos iniciales como entrenador en el Bayer Leverkusen.

programme.title: The Making of Mourinho
programme.desc: Vivimos el segundo episodio del Making Off de José Mourinho, recientemente destituido como técnico del Tottenham.

programme.title: Premier Corner by Guiness 0,0
programme.desc: El recién llegado al Arsenal y ex de la Real Sociedad, Martín Zubimendi, repasa su trayectoria con Eneko en esta nueva edición de Premier Corner.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Oviedo - Real Madrid
programme.desc: El conjunto madridista vuelve a tierras asturianas después de muchas temporadas. Enfrente tendrá a un Oviedo repleto de ilusión por volver a jugar en primera ante su afición.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Rayo - Barcelona
programme.desc: Los pupilos de Flick visitan un campo siempre complicado como Vallecas.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Barcelona - Getafe
programme.desc: El estadio Johan Cruyff vuelve a acoger al Barcelona como local en partido de Liga. Los azulgranas quieren culminar una gran semana (goleada al Valencia y triunfo en Champions) sumando tres nuevos puntos. El Getafe también ha iniciado muy bien la temporada.

programme.title: Masterclass
programme.desc: Nico Williams, el talentoso extremo del Athletic Club, es el primer jugador en pasar por nuestro 'Masterclass' y analizarnos sus goles y habilidades con el balón.

programme.title: Davide, el príncipe Ancelotti
programme.desc: Entrevista con Davide Ancelotti en la que habla de su futuro como posible entrenador del Real Madrid.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Villarreal - Girona
programme.desc: El equipo castellonense recibe a un Girona a la espera de los últimos refuerzos para una plantilla con deficiencias.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Betis - Athletic
programme.desc: Enfrentamiento entre dos equipos que han empezado bien el campeonato. El conjunto vasco llega a Sevilla tras conseguir dos valiosas victorias que lo han situado en la zona Champions.

programme.title: Bordando la segunda estrella
programme.desc: La Selección ha hecho historia en el Mundial. La cita de México, Canadá y Estados Unidos quedará guardada por siempre en la memoria de la afición española. El combinado dirigido por Luis de la Fuente alzó en Nueva York la copa y bordó la segunda estrella en el escudo.

programme.title: The Making of Mourinho: El Comienzo
programme.desc: En 2003, El Manchester United de Sir Alex Ferguson recibió en Old Trafford al Oporto de José Mourinho en un tenso partido de octavos de final de la UEFA Champions League. Un encuentro que desempeñaría un papel clave en la carrera de uno de los entrenadores más exitosos de la historia.

programme.title: The Making of Mourinho
programme.desc: Vivimos el segundo episodio del Making Off de José Mourinho, recientemente destituido como técnico del Tottenham.

programme.title: The Making of Mourinho: El Mago
programme.desc: José Mourinho fue nombrado entrenador del Real Madrid con una complicada misión: detener al FC Barcelona de Pep Guardiola. En abril de 2012, el equipo blanco viajó al Camp Nou para jugar el Clásico sabiendo que sólo una derrota podía impedirles ganar el título de Liga.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: At. Madrid - Real Madrid
programme.desc: Los mejores clubes del país protagonizan LaLiga, el campeonato de la regularidad del fútbol español. El torneo es una carrera de fondo en la que los equipos pelean por sus metas: la salvación, Europa, la Champions o el título. El Barcelona defiende corona.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Real Oviedo - Barcelona
programme.desc: Los mejores clubes del país protagonizan LaLiga, el campeonato de la regularidad del fútbol español. El torneo es una carrera de fondo en la que los equipos pelean por sus metas: la salvación, Europa, la Champions o el título. El Barcelona defiende corona.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Barcelona - Athletic
programme.desc: El Barcelona regresa al Camp Nou casi 30 meses después de su último partido en su feudo. Y lo hace con un partido grande. Los azulgranas reciben al Athletic con la intención de intensificar la presión por el liderato.

programme.title: Masterclass
programme.desc: Jugadores de primer nivel muestran sus habilidades con el balón.

programme.title: Talleres de Reminiscencia LaLiga
programme.desc: El documental refleja la dimensión de estos talleres a través del fútbol, destacando la sesión realizada en el museo de LEGENDS. El fútbol es una herramienta clave para que los protagonistas sean capaces de recuperar recuerdos, especialmente en personas con vínculos emocionales con el deporte. Unión perfecta para ayudar a las personas mayores a revivir recuerdos ligados al fútbol.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Betis - R. Sociedad
programme.desc: La quinta jornada liguera arranca con partidazo en Sevilla. El Betis, con seis puntos, recibe a una Real Sociedad que todavía no conoce la victoria, por lo que llega al feudo verdiblanco con la urgencia de revertir su mala situación.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Sevilla - Villarreal

Cela commence par une victoire dès cette première journée face à Sochaux, promu de Ligue 3.

programme.title: Football : Match amical

En attendant les mondialistes, lui et ses coéquipiers affrontent Majorque afin de préparer la saison à venir.

programme.title: Football : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Direction le BMO Field de Toronto pour suivre une rencontre explosive et imprévisible entre le Portugal et la Croatie, deux ambitieux et solides outsiders. Portés par Luka Modric, leur légendaire capitaine, les "Vatreni" vont tenter de prendre le dessus sur une sélection portugaise relativement décevante lors d'un premier tour en dents de scie, marqué notamment pas deux matchs nuls, face à la République démocratique du Congo et face à la Colombie. Cristiano Ronaldo et consorts auront sans nul doute à coeur de montrer un tout autre visage au cours d'une rencontre à élimination directe.

programme.title: Football : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Impressionnante, l'Argentine s'est aisément qualifiée pour les seizièmes de finale avec trois victoires en autant de matchs au sein d'un groupe pourtant solide. Emmenée par son mythique capitaine Leo Messi, l'Albiceleste espère poursuivre son sans-faute dans la compétition face au modeste Cap-Vert, qui a réussi l'exploit de sortir des poules pour sa première participation. Le petit poucet jouera sans nul doute crânement sa chance et tentera de contenir le plus longtemps possible les assauts de l'armada argentine, tout en essayant de profiter des moindres espaces pour partir en contre.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

The contestant with the most points at the end of the game advances to play the bonus round, in which the contestant has a chance to win thousands of dollars, with the actual amount dependent on the rules in place at the time of the episode.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Family Feud
programme.desc: In this original version of iconic game show "Family Feud," actor Richard Dawson plays host to two teams, each comprised of five family members, who try to match the answers given to survey questions asked to groups of people (typically 100 people in the group). The family that wins the game by being the first to reach a certain point total, either 200 or 300 depending on the rules at the time, advances to the bonus round, called Fast Money, for a chance to win thousands of dollars by answering more survey questions.

Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including 20 Emmys and three Peabody Awards.

programme.title: 60 Minutes
programme.desc: The oldest and most-watched newsmagazine on television gets the real story on America's most prevalent issues. CBS News correspondents contribute segments to each hourlong episode. Topics range from hard news coverage to politics, lifestyle, pop culture, business, health, and science. The correspondents and contributors include Sharyn Alfonsi, Anderson Cooper, Steve Kroft, Lara Logan, Norah O'Donnell, Scott Pelley, Charlie Rose, Lesley Stahl, Jon Wertheim, Oprah Winfrey and Bill Whitaker.

programme.title: NHL Hockey

programme.title: NHL Hockey

programme.title: NHL Hockey

programme.title: Journey: A Voice Lost... and Found
programme.desc: Journey dominated the American music scene in the seventies and eighties with their epic arena rock anthems and power ballads. Frontman Steve Perry was dubbed The Voice thanks to the untouchable vocal stylings that burned up the radio waves and made him a household name. But the bigger Journey got, the more miserable Perry grew. He was the rare rock superstar who craved anonymity more than applause. Then at the height of the band's success, Perry did the completely unthinkable-he quit Journey. That should've been an absolute death knell for a band so defined by a single voice. But Journey's other longtime members refused to give up the dream and brought in a new singer to keep the music going. Fans were livid that anyone would dare to try to fill Steve Perry's shoes-shows were played in empty houses and threats were even made against the band.

programme.title: MGM's Big Parade of Comedy
programme.desc: This documentary from Robert Youngson features clips from a variety of classic MGM comedies. Spanning four decades worth of laughs -- and including material dating from the silent era -- this compilation includes routines from comedy greats such as Laurel and Hardy, W.C. Fields, Buster Keaton, Abbott and Costello and the Three Stooges. Highlights include Red Skelton's two-sided flag routine from "A Southern Yankee" and snippets from the Marx Brothers' "A Night at the Opera.".

programme.title: Double Dynamite
programme.desc: Johnny Dalton (Frank Sinatra), a poor bank teller who works tirelessly to save enough money to marry his doting girlfriend (Jane Russell), comes across a fortune when he rescues a duplicitous bookie (Nestor Paiva) from attackers. As a misguided sign of thanks, the bookie gives Dalton an ample cash gift -- which curiously matches the amount missing from his bank. Now suspected of embezzlement, the bewildered Dalton turns to his best friend, a wily and wacky waiter (Groucho Marx), for help.

programme.title: A Girl in Every Port
programme.desc: Inheriting $1,450 upon the death of his aunt, gullible sailor Tim Dunnovan (William Bendix) purchases a race horse, to the dismay of his best friend, Benny Linn (Groucho Marx), who assumes Tim has been swindled. Tim and Benny learn that the horse, Little Erin, has weak ankles and is a poor racer -- but his devoted groom reveals that he has a twin, Little Shamrock, in excellent condition. Discovering the whereabouts of Little Shamrock, Benny schemes to switch the horses, but complications arise.

programme.title: The Big Store
programme.desc: Private detectives Wolf J. Flywheel, Wacky and Ravelli (The Marx Brothers) are hired by the officious Martha Phelps (Margaret Dumont), co-owner of the Phelps Department Store. Her beloved nephew, Tommy (Tony Martin), has been assaulted, shortly after he announced plans to sell his share of the store. Unbeknownst to Martha, the culprit is her fiancé, sleazy store manager Mr. Grover (Douglas Dumbrille), who wants Tommy dead before the sale exposes his years of fraud and theft.

programme.title: At the Circus
programme.desc: At the Circus features the Marx Brothers (Groucho, Harpo, Chico) working together to save a circus from closing. Circus owner Jeff (Kenny Baker) needs $10,000 to pay off his business partner, John. In an effort to take over the circus himself, John allows his accomplices to steal the $10,000 from Jeff before he can pay. Loophole (Groucho Marx), a clumsy attorney who tries to help recover the money, enlists the help of wealthy Mrs. Dukesbury (Margaret Dumont).

programme.title: Room Service

While dodging hotel manager Gribble (Cliff Dunstan) and his henchman, Wagner (Donald MacBride), over his unpaid bills, Gordon, director Harry Binelli (Chico Marx) and manager Faker Englund (Harpo Marx) try to soothe the jangled nerves of their playwright (Frank Albertson) and convince a wealthy backer (Philip Loeb) to invest heavily in the show.

programme.title: A Day at the Races

In order to save the financially failing sanitarium and its beautiful owner, Judy Standish (Maureen O'Sullivan), Hackenbush, employee Tony (Chico Marx) and jockey Stuffy (Harpo Marx) must find ingenious ways to help Gil Stewart (Allan Jones) and his inept racehorse, Hi-Hat, win the big race.

Traveling from Italy to New York, Otis and friends rally to try and win the day.
